title: CropShift v2 training cells (MapSPAM + NASA POWER)
subtitle: Where 46 crops grow (MapSPAM 2020) matched to six NASA POWER climate measurements

resources.description: One row per NASA POWER cell (0.5 x 0.625 deg) with farmland: 10 climate features (2001-2025 mean of six NASA POWER measurements) and MapSPAM 2020 harvested area of 46 crops (all / irrigated / rain-fed, ha).
